claims.text: The building is a protected historic landmark under the Boston Landmarks Commission.

findings.quote: As a historic landmark, the building is protected by the Boston Landmarks Commission

claims.text: The hotel's art collection pays homage to the building's banking history and local heritage.

findings.quote: a stunning art collection that pays homage to the building’s banking history and local heritage

claims.text: The Fed is a street-level bar serving pub fare, raw-bar seafood and cocktails.

findings.quote: The Fed, a street-level bar that serves elevated pub fare, raw-bar seafood, and inventive cocktails

claims.text: The Langham Club offers full breakfast with an omelet station, afternoon snacks, and evening cocktails and a light dinner.

findings.quote: full breakfast with omelet station, afternoon treats and snacks, and evening cocktails and light dinner

claims.text: The hotel has a bilevel 24-hour fitness center, a heated indoor pool, a hot tub and saunas.

findings.quote: the bilevel 24-hour fitness center with Peloton bikes, Echelon mirrors, a heated indoor pool, hot tub, and saunas

claims.text: Every subway line intersects near the hotel, giving easy access to outer neighborhoods.

findings.quote: every T (subway) line intersects here for ultra-easy access to virtually every outer neighborhood

claims.text: The minibars are stocked with Massachusetts-sourced goods.

findings.quote: not-so-mini bars stocked with Massachusetts-sourced goodies

claims.text: The Chairman Suite has a walk-in closet, a fireplace and a piano.

findings.quote: a full walk-in closet, fireplace, and piano

claims.text: The hotel sources most of its ingredients from New England purveyors and businesses.

findings.quote: We source most of our ingredients from New England purveyors and businesses.

findings.quote: ADA-compliant, with wheelchair-accessible rooms and elevators.

claims.text: The building dates from 1922 and was formerly the Federal Reserve Bank of Boston before being converted into a hotel in 1981.

findings.quote: Built in 1922, The Langham was formerly The Federal Reserve Bank of Boston before being converted into a hotel in 1981.

claims.text: The former bank left behind two early-20th-century N.C. Wyeth murals.

findings.quote: the bank left behind two towering early-20th-century N.C. Wyeth murals
